facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L2_tax_id: RUC, a 14-digit number from the DGI, registered with your cédula.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Only Nicaraguan-source income taxed, at rates up to 30%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT; all traders must register, no threshold stated.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
facts.L7_incentives: Fixed monthly quota regime for income up to C$480,000 a year (older figure).
